title: Block-Position Structure in Reduced ChaCha20 and Salsa20: Experimental Diagnostics of IV Diffusion — Data and Code

creators.name: Augustynowicz, Paweł
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Cybernetics, Military University of Technology, Warsaw, Poland

description: Data and code for experimental diagnostics of IV diffusion in reduced ChaCha20 and Salsa20. Version 0.20.0 revises the single-article v0.19.0 manuscript after an advisory review, without a supplementary manuscript. It distinguishes the loss of conditional affinity in the unfinalized word-7 map from block-scale structure in the standard additive output, clarifies the null hypotheses and sign-flip assumptions and the order of spectrum normalization and averaging, and displays observed and frozen-model mean AC spectra using retained data. The contribution is positioned as a connection between conditional identities, paired finalization effects and empirical spectral reconstruction; no unverified priority claim is added. The models retain training keys 840–919, 4096 Monte Carlo key pairs per model, and evaluation keys 1200–1279; the single-round cohort retains keys 1400–1479. This release generates no new cipher observations or model simulations. Earlier raw arrays, protocols, numerical results, scientific code and the reference database remain unchanged. Historical figures and exact corollary documentation inputs remain in the research archive alongside the new plot and its provenance. The archive is prepared for reviewers; it has not been submitted or publicly deposited. The advisory review was not a formally validated ARS panel. The results establish neither detector superiority nor a full-round weakness or attack advantage.
